rows.note: Use this when directing your mental attention to something rather than gathering physical things or thickening a substance.

example.english: I need to concentrate on studying today; I can't get distracted.
example.traditional: 我今日要集中精神溫書，唔可以分心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 wan1 syu1 m4 ho2 ji5 fan1 sam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for bringing things together or having people and things gather in one place.

example.english: We need to concentrate on doing this report.
example.traditional: 我哋要集中精神做呢份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 zou6 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this specifically when reducing a substance's volume while making it stronger or denser.

example.english: Concentrate the fruit juice to save space.
example.traditional: 將啲果汁濃縮吓，可以慳位。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 di1 gwo2 zap1 nung4 suk1 haa5 ho2 ji5 haan1 wai2
